Core visible stats are set to 20, Fusion is set to 6, Become Lightning is unlocked, and route-specific battle options are available where their conditions are met.</p> <p>This does not touch checkpoint saves.</p> </div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Start Philip Gerkle's boss fight->Philip Battle Begins]]</div><div class="choice-row">[[Start at Philip's deal choice->Gerkle Decision]]</div><div class="choice-row">[[Choose another moment->Jump to Moment]]</div></div>(set: $postOdelynInterludeSeen to true)(set: $postOdelynSideStory to "")(set: $philipRouteSeen to false)(set: $philipDealAccepted to false)(set: $philipDefeated to false)(set: $philipSpared to false) <div class="narrative-box">The lesson with Odelyn does not leave when Odelyn does. Pela sits in the quiet after The Lost and feels the shape of every place she is still weak. The Forbidden One has been important. Too important. Prolonged exposure to that grimoire is not education anymore. It is a ramp. It is a hand on her back. It is possessive power pretending to be guidance.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Let the day open around her->Post Odelyn Interlude Choice]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela understands that she passed Odelyn's test. She does not feel accomplished. Odelyn did not put her in the infirmary. Odelyn did not break her pride the way she broke Gareth's. It really was a friend teaching a friend in a constructive manner, and somehow that makes the lesson heavier. Pela wants one day where the Academy does not decide what she becomes.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Explore Torrindale City and clear her head.")[(set: $postOdelynSideStory to "daisy")(set: $self to $self + 1)(set: $oath to $oath - 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Self")(goto: "Interlude City Gate")]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Stay in the dorm and process Odelyn's lesson.")[(set: $postOdelynSideStory to "dorm")(set: $spark to $spark + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Spark")(goto: "Dorm Recovery Start")]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Go to the Royal Library before the feeling fades.")[(set: $postOdelynSideStory to "philip")(set: $research to $research + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Research")(goto: "Library Day Approach")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela leaves campus with a little money and a mind full of unfinished spells. Torrindale City waits beyond the academy gates. She has seen pieces of it from classroom windows, but mostly she has lived between dormitory walls, lecture halls, and places where professors decide whether fear counts as failure.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Walk until the city stops feeling like a test->Interlude City Money]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Keep one hand near her spell focus.")[(set: $spark to $spark + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Spark")(goto: "Interlude City Money")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">The streets are busy enough that Pela can almost disappear. Almost. A few people stare at her horns. A few stare at her skin. Most are too busy selling fruit, ink, charms, fried bread, bad poetry, and worse advice. That helps more than kindness would have.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Follow the sound of music->Bard District Lights]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Nothing catches her eye until she arrives at the Bard's District. Food, drinks, entertainment, and arcane artisans crowd the streets. Lanterns hang bright over the road. The air smells like sugar, old wood, hot oil, and mana spent for applause. It reminds her of celebrations in Orgoshk, which is unfair because she was trying not to miss home.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Let the district pull her deeper->Musician Shoppe Sign]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Compare the lights to Orgoshk instead of Brittanica.")[(set: $self to $self + 1)(set: $oath to $oath - 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Self")(goto: "Musician Shoppe Sign")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">A sign reads The Musician's Shoppe. Pela stops because curiosity still has power over her, even after everything else that has tried. Music spills through the door in low, warm notes. It does not sound like the Academy. It sounds like someone making a room belong to them.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Enter the shop->Musician Shoppe Inside]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Listen from the doorway first.")[(set: $trust to $trust + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Trust")(goto: "Musician Shoppe Inside")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Inside the shop, a bard sits on a boulder in the middle of the room, tuning a dark wooden instrument. The wood is too familiar. The carvings along its body look almost goblin. Not the exaggerated version Brittanican artists draw when they want something to seem primitive. The real kind. Careful. Practical. Full of tiny jokes only the maker understood.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Approach the musician->Daisy Bass Correction]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"I like your guitar," Pela blurts out before she can make herself sound normal. "Thanks, but this is a bass." For a moment, Pela looks blankly at the person tuning their instrument.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Ask how to tell the difference.")[(set: $trust to $trust + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Trust")(goto: "Daisy Peg Lesson")]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Admit she has no idea what she is looking at.")[(set: $self to $self + 1)(set: $oath to $oath - 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Self")(goto: "Daisy Peg Lesson")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"Do you want to know how to tell the difference between the two instruments?" "Yes... please," Pela asks, her tone hesitant. "A bass has four tuning pegs," the person says, excitedly showing Pela. "A standard guitar has six pegs." "Ah," Pela says. "That's cool."</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Let her introduce herself->Daisy Introduction]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"Right! I'm glad you also see it my way. Anyway, I'm Daisy." "Pela," she replies, shy despite herself. Daisy smiles like names are not traps. "So," Pela asks, "do you know how to play it?"</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Listen to Daisy play->Daisy First Song]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Ask if the instrument is hard to learn.")[(set: $research to $research + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Research")(goto: "Daisy First Song")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"Of course!" Daisy says. "I can show you, if you'd like?" "I'd love that!" Daisy starts playing. Pela's eyes widen. The sound is beautiful in a way that makes her homesick before she has time to defend herself.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Recognize the wood->Orgoshk Wood]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Her memory is not deceiving her. The longer Daisy plays, the more obvious it becomes. The dark wood is from Orgoshk. It carries the same resonance as the lute Pela has at home. Goblin instruments have a distinct sound. It is craft, but not only craft. Mana lives in the wood until music and magic agree to be one.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Ask if Daisy has ever been to Orgoshk.")[(set: $trust to $trust + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Trust")(goto: "Goblin Instrument Lore")]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Tell Daisy what the wood is.")[(set: $research to $research + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Research")(goto: "Goblin Instrument Lore")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"Have you ever been to Orgoshk?" Pela asks. "No," Daisy says, equally curious. "But I've always wanted to go. Why do you ask?" "The bass you're using is made from the same wood as my lute back home," Pela explains. "The wood has magical properties. I've never heard any human play it with such skill. It takes a goblin to truly master the art of playing a goblin instrument." "I had no idea!" Daisy says.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Hear what Daisy does with that knowledge->Daisy Star Music]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Daisy plays again. This time the music rises louder, brighter, and more intense. To Pela's demon eyes, the magic around Daisy looks like stars pinned across a night sky. It is colorful. It is alive. It is not ashamed of being felt.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Watch the music become emotion->Daisy Emotion Attuned]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Let herself miss home openly.")[(set: $self to $self + 1)(set: $oath to $oath - 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Self")(goto: "Daisy Emotion Attuned")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Daisy is magically attuned to her emotions. Pela loves that about her immediately, maybe because it is everything the Academy keeps trying to turn into a warning. Daisy does not look controlled by the music. She looks like an artist painting a picture with it.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Let Daisy offer a lesson->Daisy Offer Lesson]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"You can try a few notes," Daisy offers. Pela looks at the bass like it is both instrument and relic. Part of her wants to touch it. Part of her worries the sound will make home feel farther away.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Try the bass gently.")[(set: $spark to $spark + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Spark")(goto: "Pela Tries Bass")]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Respect the instrument and only listen.")[(set: $trust to $trust + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Trust")(goto: "Pela Refuses Bass Touch")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela touches the strings carefully. The note that comes out is ugly. Daisy laughs, but not cruelly. Pela laughs too, startled by how much easier it is to fail when no one is keeping score.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Let the moment stay kind->Daisy Laughs Softly]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"I think I just want to listen," Pela admits. Daisy nods like that is a complete answer. No professor corrects her. No student snickers. No demon calls the choice weakness.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Let the moment stay kind->Daisy Laughs Softly]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">For a little while, Pela is only a girl in a music shop. That feels impossible enough to be magic. Daisy keeps playing until the afternoon begins to lean toward evening and the Bard's District grows louder outside.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Leave the Musician's Shoppe->Bard District After Music]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Outside, the city feels different. Not safer. Brittanica has not earned that. But less singular. The Academy is not the whole world. There are shops where mistakes become jokes, songs that understand homesickness, and people who do not turn Pela into a problem the second she enters a room.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Decide what to do with the rest of the day->Day One After Daisy]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Evening settles over Torrindale. Pela can go back to the dorms and keep this small mercy clean. Or she can make the day useful in the way the Academy understands usefulness.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Go back to the dorms and let the day end->Skip Gerkle Dorm Choice]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Visit the Royal Library before returning.")[(set: $postOdelynSideStory to "daisy-philip")(set: $research to $research + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Research")(goto: "Daisy To Royal Library")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela returns to the dorms before curiosity can become another trap. The city stays behind her. The music follows longer than the lantern light. For once, she lets a good thing remain good instead of digging under it for teeth.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Sleep before the next summons finds her->Daisy Return To Dorm]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela stays in her dorm. It is not brave. It is not cowardly. It is a room with a door she can close. Odelyn's lesson keeps moving through her head. Using emotions to cast spells is not the same as letting emotions wear her like a coat.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Practice Become Lightning in small bursts->Dorm Blade Reflection]]</div><div class="choice-row">[[Write down what Odelyn taught her->Dorm Letter Thought]]</div><div class="choice-row">[[Do nothing until the silence becomes useful->Dorm Quiet Practice]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela practices the beginning of Become Lightning without allowing the spell to take her all the way. Spark gathers in her limbs. Her heartbeat tries to become a command. She stops before speed turns into running.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Hold the current steady.")[(set: $spark to $spark + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Spark")(goto: "Dorm Sleep Before Dream")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela writes one sentence. I passed. Then she scratches it out, because it is true and not true enough. She writes another. I am not where I want to be yet.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Keep the second sentence.")[(set: $self to $self + 1)(set: $oath to $oath - 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Self")(goto: "Dorm Sleep Before Dream")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela does nothing. At first, it feels like wasting time. Then it becomes something else. Her body stops bracing for the next correction. Her magic settles. Her thoughts stop sprinting long enough for her to catch them.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Let rest count as preparation.")[(set: $trust to $trust + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Trust")(goto: "Dorm Sleep Before Dream")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">By the time Pela lies down, Odelyn's voice has stopped sounding like judgment. Act like it. Pela does not know if she can. She falls asleep anyway.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Let the next dream find her->Dorm Return To Dream]]</div></div>(set: $philipRouteSeen to true) <div class="narrative-box">Pela continues through the city with her mind wandering back to family. She has not heard from them in too long. Not because she thinks they are in danger. Orgoshk is safer for them than Torrindale is for her. The worry is simpler than that. She misses them.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Enter the Royal Library of Torrindale City->Royal Library Exterior]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">The Royal Library of Torrindale City rises larger than any building has a right to be. Pela has never visited it before. If answers can be found anywhere in this city, she wants to believe they can be found here.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Walk beneath the library arches->Royal Library Scale]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">The library is the largest on the continent of Solitrium, excluding Bingham's University. Pela does not really consider Bingham a true country of mages. It is a country of pretentious and absurd hermits, and she will never step foot in there.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Let the thought become petty enough to help->Bingham Thought]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Admit she would rather be here than anywhere in Bingham.")[(set: $nerve to $nerve + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Nerve")(goto: "Bingham Thought")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Of the three Great Mage Countries, Brittanica Ultima, Bingham, and the Theocracy of Athea, Bingham is the most insular. Pela would rather stay in the Torrindale Library forever than visit either of the other two countries and pretend their arrogance is culture.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Find the book that makes the hunger wake->Feastcraft Shelf]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">While pondering, Pela comes across a book called Feastcraft. The title is enough. Her hunger recognizes it before her hands do.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Reach for Feastcraft->Philip Takes Book]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Study why the title feels alive.")[(set: $forbidden to $forbidden + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Forbidden")(goto: "Philip Takes Book")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela reaches for the book. Someone else grabs it first. "I don't think this book is for you," a voice says.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Ask who he thinks he is.")[(set: $nerve to $nerve + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Nerve")(goto: "Philip Names Himself")]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Demand a reason before anger becomes magic.")[(set: $research to $research + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Research")(goto: "Philip Names Himself")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"Why not?" Pela asks. "Who are you to say what I can and can't read?" "My name is Philip Gerkle, and I am a professional researcher of Arcane Artificing here at Torrindale."</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Look at him properly->Philip Description]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Philip Gerkle looks creepy. He is a pale elf with a scar that starts at his bottom lip and ends at his right ear. His eyes are piercing blue. His hair is dark enough to make his skin look even paler.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Notice the earrings->Valis Earrings]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Keep looking until the detail matters.")[(set: $research to $research + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Research")(goto: "Valis Earrings")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">His earrings remind Pela of Valis, one of the three Alter Gods. They are shaped like crescent moons textured as raven feathers, and the chain is bright bronze. She knows this because her parents taught her the old stories. The Alter Gods are not worshipped in the main Brittanican cities, but they are recognized on the outskirts of the kingdom.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Return to the argument->Advanced Book Argument]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"This is a very advanced book for a student to understand," Philip says. "You should start with something simpler, like The Fundamentals of Arcane Artificing." "Does that make you better than me or something?" Pela asks. "Because if you are going to say I'm just a student, then that is not going to stop me."</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Feel why the book matters->Hunger Knows Tome]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela wants that book because it is related to the Saint of the Feast. She can see it with her demon eyes. She can tell deep down by the hunger it makes her feel. She knows this and will not admit it to Philip.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Call herself a researcher too.")[(set: $research to $research + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Research")(goto: "Claim Researcher")]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Hold out her palm for the book.")[(set: $nerve to $nerve + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Nerve")(goto: "Claim Researcher")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"You called yourself a researcher, not a professor," Pela says. "By that logic I am also a researcher of arcane artificing, so hand me the book." She finishes the sentence with her hand open and her palm facing Philip. "Absolutely not," Philip huffs.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Ask why Feastcraft is so important->Ask Why Important]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"Fine," Pela says. "Can you at least tell me why it's so important?" "It's about a lost school of magic," Philip replies. "That is why it is important, and why I need it for my research."</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Ask about his research->Ask Research]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Watch his hands instead of his answer.")[(set: $research to $research + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Research")(goto: "Ask Research")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"What is your research?" Pela asks. "That's none of your business," Philip retorts. "Fine," Pela mutters. The word tastes like losing.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Walk away from him and the book->Walk Away Hungry]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela walks away, but the hunger gnaws at her. It is like her stomach is screaming for her to consume the knowledge within that book. Now that she has seen it, she can find it again.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Reach the library doors->Library Door Resistance]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">At the library doors, Pela stops. She can go home and try to calm herself. She can follow the hunger until it becomes a map. The rational part of Pela wants Feastcraft because it might help her break the curse. The other part wants it because the Saint is hungry.</div> <div class="choice-list">(if: $self >= 2)[<div class="choice-row choice-row-unclaimed">(link: "Tell the hunger no and return to the dorm (DC Self: 2)")[(set: $self to $self + 1)(set: $oath to $oath - 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Self")(goto: "Unclaimed Refuse Chase")]</div>]<div class="choice-row">[[Go home and try to calm herself->Gate Hunger Rising]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Follow the hunger before it tears through her restraint.")[(set: $oath to $oath + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Oath")(goto: "Night Streets Hunger")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box unclaimed-box"><span class="unclaimed-mark"></span>Pela keeps walking away. The hunger screams like she has betrayed it. Maybe she has. "You can want something without being owned by wanting it," Pela whispers, and the sentence hurts enough to feel true.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row choice-row-unclaimed">[[Return to the dorm with empty hands->Unclaimed Refuse Return]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">As Pela approaches the gate to leave Torrindale City, the hunger becomes unbearable. The demon within her starts to scream. She has to get that book.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Lose the argument with herself->Night Streets Hunger]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">It is late in the night when Pela returns to Torrindale's streets. The hunger leads her. Not like a thought. Like a hook behind her ribs.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Follow it into the Ossuary District->Ossuary District]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">The Ossuary District is where the dead are laid to rest and outdated temples survive because Brittanicans hate gods less than they love archives. The area is rundown and quiet. Pela finds what she is looking for near a temple of Valis.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Approach the temple->Temple of Valis]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Notice how old worship rots when no one admits it is worship.")[(set: $research to $research + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Research")(goto: "Temple of Valis")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela can feel the book's presence, and the demon within her rejoices. <span class="forbidden-voice-soft">'Philip Gerkle is in the same vicinity of the book. What will you do?'</span> a voice asks inside her mind. <span class="forbidden-voice-soft">'I'll fight him if I have to. I can't let this book escape me,'</span> Pela thinks.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Snap out of the hunger for one breath->Coin Of Hunger]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela snaps out of it before walking into the ugly monolith. She cannot let herself get that desperate. Yes, part of her wants the book because of the Saint of the Feast's hunger. But the rational part wants it because it might help her break this curse. Two sides of a coin. One to free herself from the gnawing. One to indulge in it.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Enter the run-down building->Run Down Building]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">The main section of the building seems innocuous enough. There is only a giant statue of Valis at its center. No guard. No priest. No sign that anyone living has cared about this place in years.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Study the statue as she passes->Valis Statue]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">The statue looks like an owl with a raven's beak, feathers carved to resemble silk, and horns of a stag. A crown of talons sits on its head. It has been here for a long time, waiting for people to either worship it or pretend they are only preserving history.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Descend into the crypt->Crypt Hallway]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">The stairs lead into a hallway with tombs on either side. Each tomb is marked with a half crescent shape with horns sticking out of each corner. Candles are lit. Philip is down here.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Follow the chanting->Chanting Mana Path]]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Read the mana path he left behind.")[(set: $forbidden to $forbidden + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Forbidden")(goto: "Chanting Mana Path")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">The voice ahead is not normal chatter. It is chanting. Pela cannot make out the words, but she knows it is Philip. His mana path is not usual mana. It is laced with something wicked enough that even a normal person might feel the air trying to leave.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Enter the grand room->Monolith Chamber]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Deep beneath the temple, Philip stands near a monolith of Valis. Feastcraft lies on the altar. For one second, the hunger makes the book the center of the room.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[See what else is on the altars->Goblin Altars]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Four goblins lie on separate altars at the four cardinal directions of the room. They are clearly butchered. It saddens Pela to see non-human blood spilled in a place that will not mourn them. If she was not here, no one would have even known.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Threaten Philip before grief becomes panic.")[(set: $nerve to $nerve + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Nerve")(goto: "Pela Threatens Philip")]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Hold the spell ready before speaking.")[(set: $spark to $spark + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Spark")(goto: "Pela Threatens Philip")]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"Move and I will annihilate you." Pela's voice booms through the chamber before she has time to decide if the threat is wise. Philip turns slowly.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Hear his calm answer->Philip Says Talk]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"I'm not here to fight. We can just talk," Philip says, his tone calm. The calm makes him worse. There is blood on the altars and a book that wants Pela to stop looking at anything else.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Ask about the bodies->Ask Bodies]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"What do you plan to do with the bodies of these poor people," Pela asks, "and why did you kill them?" Philip's expression does not change quickly enough to count as shame.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Hear what he calls them->Philip Cruel Answer]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"Well, they can hardly be called people," Philip says. "And, as for what I plan to do with them..." His response nearly makes Pela's blood boil. She forces herself to stay magically ready instead.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Keep anger useful->Pela Holds Anger]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Odelyn already taught her this. Emotions are weapons. That does not mean letting loose her inhibitions and allowing them to take over. Using emotions to cast spells is not the same as letting them cloud judgment.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Give Philip one more chance->Philip Feastcraft Plan]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"You have one more chance to answer me. I'm not in the mood for theatrics." "I plan to use Feastcraft in combination with these goblins to create an unholy abomination," Philip answers. "I figured someone with your stench would understand." He smiles. "Or did you want to join me?"</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Demand what he means by stench->Stench Accusation]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"What do you mean, my stench?! Do you mean because I'm half-demon?" "Members of the Feasting Guild can smell the stench of others who have made deals with our Saint," Philip says. "You smell like the pits of the abyss."</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Tell him it is a curse->Curse Not Pact]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"I don't know who the Saint of the Feast is, and frankly I don't want to know." "Liar. You are seeking the same book as I, and yet you have the gall to say you know nothing about the Saint? The black stench is basically seeping out of your pores." "It's a curse!" Pela snaps. "I didn't choose this!"</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Hear the offer that should not exist->Philip Offers Deal]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"Right. Whatever. I don't have time for this nonsense," Philip says. "The ritual is almost complete, and I will be leaving this pitiful excuse of a country soon." He laughs. Then he stops. "Tell you what. If you let me finish my work in peace, I will give you the book. No. Strings. Attached."</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Decide what kind of person gets Feastcraft->Gerkle Decision]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela looks at Feastcraft. Then at the bodies. Then at Philip. The hunger has an answer. Rage has an answer. Fear has an answer. Pela has to choose which one she is willing to hear.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">(link: "Accept the deal and take the book.")[(set: $philipDealAccepted to true)(set: $oath to $oath + 1)(set: $shame to $shame + 1)(set: $nerve to $nerve - 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Oath, +1 Shame")(goto: "Accept Deal")]</div><div class="choice-row">(link: "Reject the deal and stop him.")[(set: $spark to $spark + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Spark")(goto: "Reject Deal")]</div>(if: $nerve >= 14)[<div class="choice-row choice-row-jerk">(link: "Tell Philip he talks too much for someone standing near dead bodies (DC Nerve: 14, Spend: 2 Nerve)")[(set: $jerkTone to $jerkTone + 1)(set: $nerve to $nerve - 2)(set: $gain to "-2 Nerve")(goto: "Reject Deal")]</div>]</div><div class="narrative-box">"Okay," Pela agrees. Her voice sounds hesitant. It should. Philip continues his evil machinations while Pela stands in the corner and feels every second become a stain.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Watch the ritual finish->Accept Ritual Watching]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">The four goblins rise from their altars. For half a heartbeat, Pela thinks they are alive. Then their souls are forcibly taken from their bodies.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Watch them look at Pela->Goblin Souls Taken]]</div></div>(set: $shame to $shame + 1)(set: $nerve to $nerve - 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Shame") <div class="narrative-box">They look to Pela for a split second as they are ripped from their mortal vessels. The mana of their souls slowly flows into a vial Philip Gerkle holds up. Pela does not move. That is the worst part. Pela just stands there.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Hear what he made->Stitching Draught]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"It's called the Stitching Draught," Philip explains. "A potion that allows me to change shape. The shape is based on who I consume and their attributes." His voice becomes a cackle. "The more I have, the better."</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Let him leave with what he stole->Philip Leaves Book]]</div></div>(set: $forbidden to $forbidden + 1)(set: $gain to "+1 Forbidden") <div class="narrative-box">Philip leaves the chamber. His laughter echoes throughout the temple. All that remains is Feastcraft. The book she was unwilling to fight for. The book she still had to pay for. The price was dignity, honor, and pride.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Take Feastcraft with hands that feel unclean->Accept Return Dorm]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela returns to the dorm with Feastcraft hidden under her arm. The Saint does not congratulate her. It does not need to. The hunger is quiet in the way a fed thing is quiet.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Sleep badly before the Dean's summons->Philip Deal Return]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"No," Pela says. "After what you did to these poor people, I will make sure you pay." Philip's amusement drains away. "Then we will have to fight."</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Stop him before he escapes->Chase Through Temple]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Philip grabs Feastcraft and runs toward an exit Pela did not notice before. She is hot on his tail, but she has to stop him without hitting the book. The hunger wants her to be careless. Odelyn's lesson refuses.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Become lightning and close the gap->Become Lightning Grapple]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">Pela uses Become Lightning to immediately close the gap. Philip is not prepared for this. She throws him to the ground, grabs the Feastcraft tome from him, and hurls it to a safe distance.</div> <div class="choice-list"><div class="choice-row">[[Refuse his attempt to talk->Flesh Stitch Escape]]</div></div><div class="narrative-box">"Stop! Let's talk about this." "No! You don't get to talk your way out of this!" Philip says the words of a spell Pela has never heard before. "Flesh: Stitch."
